page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Hebrew, Chaldee, Syriac and Latin entries; no margin notes; running head at top; page number at top right; final line "Ab Heb-" at lower right as a catchword-like continuation.

main_text.p: בזז Ch.& Syr. Diripere, Depraedari, Spoliare. Aph. Praet. אבז Spoliavit, Jer.25.36. Hebr. שיד Vastavit. Particip. מביז Spolians, Hebr. בזקק Evacuat, Jesa.24.1. Ithpeh אתבזיז Diripi, Spoliari.
בזוא בזוא Ch.Praedo, Direptor, Prov.25.19. Plural. בזוין. Foemin. לאומא בבליתא בזוזיתא Gens Babylonica rapax, Psal.137.v.penult.
בזתא , בזא Ch. Praeda, spolium. Plur. בזן , בזת ; Syriace כזןם Spolia ejus, Lucae 11.22.
בוז Ch. Idem, Esth.3.13. in T.sec.
בוח כוזבח Pahel Syr. Illudere, irridere. Ethpahel כוזבח Illudi. Deducitur juxta quosdam, a בזר praeced. ח & ח commutatis.
כוזבן Syr.Illusio, Ludificatio, Irrisio, Ludibrium, ad Ephes.5.4. Plur. כוזבין , ad Hebr. 11.36.
בזך Ch. Acerra, Thymiaterium. Plural. בזיכא , בזיכין.
בזע Ch.& Syr. Scidit, discidit, fidit, rupit, dilaceravit: Transfixit, Numer.25.8. Pahel בזע Idem. Ithpeh. אתבזע Scindi, rumpi, disrumpi, findi.
בזעא Ch. כוזען Syr. Ruptura, Scissura, Matth.9.16. Plural. בזעתא Chald. Laceramenta, vestes lacerae, Proverb.23.21.
בזר בזרא Chald. Semen, Genes.1.11. in Targ. Jon.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac script is transcribed approximately; several vocalised forms are uncertain and not marked individually. The final line "Ab Heb-" is a catchword at the foot.
